name: Peter Schetty
features: fair hair, long face, calm analytical manner, tall slim build
bio: The European hillclimb champion of 1969 in the Ferrari 212E, promoted to the works sports car team for 1970. Shared the yellow-nosed 512S long-tail with Jacky Ickx at Le Mans and became Ferrari's team manager the following year, running the 312PB campaign that won everything.
